text:
elaine_support: FYI customer reported a major outage after our autorouter invoked revoke_api_key instead of rotate_api_key. They lost all integrations.
mark_infra: omg. Any logs or payload we can repro with? :grimacing:
sophie_sre: @elaine_support can you paste the original tool selector payload and the tool signatures it matched to?
elaine_support: copied from the webhook we forwarded. root message ts 3312345000

Payload sent to autorouter:
```json
{
  "intent": "key_management.rotate_or_revoke",
  "user_id": "acct_09X",
  "api_key_id": "key_abc123",
  "action": "rotate",
  "force": false
}
```

Tool catalog (trimmed):
```text
rotate_api_key(api_key_id: string, rotation_strategy: string = "smooth")
revoke_api_key(api_key_id: string, reason: string = "user_request")
```

luis_engineer: minimal schema overlap: both take api_key_id string. autorouter heuristics used top-level `action` field to disambiguate but our signature matcher ignored it because rotate had defaulted param name `rotation_strategy` not matching `action`.
mark_infra: logs from autorouter-bot show fuzzy score: revoke_api_key 0.67, rotate_api_key 0.65 -> picked revoke due to tie-breaker on alphabetical order (bug?)
autorouter-bot: [info] matched tools: revoke_api_key (score=0.67), rotate_api_key (score=0.65). Selected revoke_api_key. Execution started: 3312345021.
elaine_support: customer impact: all API keys for acct_09X were revoked at 14:23 UTC. They had to reissue keys manually. SEV2.
sophie_sre: mitigation steps for support team: 1) run emergency adhoc rotate for acct_09X to restore keys 2) restore previous keys if possible (we don't store plaintext) 3) escalate to infra to disable autorouter for key-management until fix. Can we automate a rollback? 
luis_engineer: we can't unrevoke, only create new keys. created a quick script to bulk recreate keys for that account, pushed to support-runbook. snippet:
```bash
# ad-hoc rotate script (for support)
for id in $(cat key_ids.txt); do 
  curl -X POST "$REDWOOD_API/v1/keys/$id/rotate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN"; 
done
```
mark_infra: I've toggled autorouter flag for namespace `key-management` to off. will leave manual until patch.
elaine_support: customer accepted manual rotate and a 50% credit. they're annoyed but staying. they asked what prevented a safety check.
sophie_sre: root cause: heuristic ignored explicit `action` because our parser only maps fields that exactly match param names; `action` !== `rotation_strategy`. Fuzzy matcher overweights common verbs (revoke/rotate) in training data. Repro steps documented.
luis_engineer: proposed fixes: 1) update matcher to prefer explicit high-confidence top-level fields like `action` 2) add safeguard: require confirmation for irreversible tools (revoke_api_key) when invoked by autorouter (prompt + two-step) 3) add unit tests for similar signature pairs.
mark_infra: quick patch: make revoke_api_key require `confirm=true` in invocation payload or else reject. rolling config in 5 min.
autorouter-bot: [deploy] config updated: revoke_api_key now requires confirm=true to execute via autorouter. 3312345300
elaine_support: thanks. please add an incident note and assign follow-up to luis_engineer for longer-term matcher changes. I'll close the customer loop.
sophie_sre: adding postmortem stub in #postmortems and tagging SEV2. steps to include: timeline, reproduction, patch, customer remediation, tests.
mark_infra: I've scheduled a quick retrospective with ML matcher owners. cc @luis_engineer

-- end of thread --
